title: Non-Fluctuating Pack
description: A Vanilla Modpack, That Contains Some Optimization And QoL mods!
body:
# About this Modpack
This Modpack based on **[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)** Modpack (from 12.21.24 based on [SimplyFine](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sif)), so You will have **most of OptiFine features** and **good optimization** with that!
# What about vanilla servers?
You can play on **ANY** vanilla server that you want with this modpack, because any mod here is **client-sided!**
# Can I use the Modpack in my own purposes?
You actually can! You can do **ANYTHING** with this Modpack, **untill** it griefs me and my reputation.
